In detail

This district covers Nea Filothei, Ampelokipoi, Goudi, Kountouriotika, Erythros Stavros, Gyzi and Polygono. Most of the district — Goudi park, Gyzi, Nea Filothei, Polygono and Kountouriotika — is leafy and residential with no documented safety concerns. Ampelokipoi, however, has a real, recurring record of gun violence: a 2021 shooting near the Athens Police headquarters (GADA), an August 2023 shooting outside a lyceum that lightly injured a bystander, and the April 2026 shooting spree by an 89-year-old gunman, whose registered address (confirmed via Athens courthouse records) placed the incident within Ampelokipoi and which wounded four people. A separate incident involving an assault on a nurse at the Red Cross Hospital is a hospital-security matter rather than a street-crime pattern. Given Ampelokipoi's recurring documented gun violence set against an otherwise quiet district, both day and night are rated yellow. Sources checked: Ethnos; To Vima; Euronews; Al Jazeera; Europost.
